# README media

These assets were captured from the compiled Seris 0.1.0 macOS client with its English interface on October 7, 2026.

| Asset | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| `workspace.png` | Live Hyperliquid BTC perpetual candles and actual analysis from the user's configured DeepSeek model. Only the public demonstration conversation is visible. |
| `markets-walkthrough.gif` | Searching for NVDA, selecting its Hyperliquid xyz perpetual, and switching the chart from 1h to 4h. Selected screenshots are held briefly to make a shortened walkthrough; timing does not represent request latency. |
| `backtest.png` | The bundled `ma-trail-stop` example run against 999 closed Binance BTCUSDT 1h candles in an isolated data directory. Starting cash is $10,000, with the engine's default 5 bps fee and 5 bps slippage. Results are historical simulations. |

Market quotes and model responses are recorded examples. Screenshots preserve the client's displayed results; no balances, returns or tool outcomes were fabricated. Model keys, personal account data and unrelated conversations are excluded.

To refresh the media, use the released client in English, capture only a public demonstration, and check each frame for private information. Keep still images readable at GitHub's content width and the GIF compact. Update the README captions and this capture record when the demonstrated version changes.

Seris branding remains subject to the [brand terms](../../apps/desktop-ui/public/brand/LICENSE.md).
